about: [O7] The havoc play, first pass (the brief's §6, on what is in main: O1's river, O4's revolver, O6's set, O1b's news; the police are O3's stand-in): by real input, the night's revolver drawn and the lamps on Grand Ave shot out - the set answers (the head's glass, the pop, a buzz, dark), the city answers the shot within the second (two shields, 'Lose them.') and the paper prints it (SHOTS FIRED); into the car with the heat on (no autosave: never under heat) and off the slipway into the river - 'The river took it.' and up on the quay with a car, the controls mine (a scene broken on purpose ends sane); out of their sight the search ('Stay out of sight.'). Nothing says no. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o7_havoc.json

steps.eval: (window.__aimLamp = () => { const S = G.stage.smash, e = G.eye; const L = [...S.near(e.x, e.z, 26)].filter((i) => i.kind === 'lamp' && i.state === 'stand' && !i.dark && !(i.flick && i.flick.dying)).map((i) => ({ i, h: (i.lamp || S.lampOf(i) || {}).head })).filter((q) => q.h && (() => { const dv = q.h.clone().sub(e); const L = dv.length(); return !G.rays.raycast(e, dv.divideScalar(L), L - 0.9, { anyHit: true }); })()).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.h.x - e.x, a.h.z - e.z) - Math.hypot(b.h.x - e.x, b.h.z - e.z)); const q = L.find((q) => Math.hypot(q.h.x - e.x, q.h.z - e.z) > 4 && Math.hypot(q.h.x - e.x, q.h.z - e.z) < 15) || L[0]; if (!q) return null; window.__lamps = (window.__lamps || new Set()).add(q.i); const d = Math.hypot(q.h.x - e.x, q.h.z - e.z); N.controller.yaw = Math.atan2(-(q.h.x - e.x), -(q.h.z - e.z)); N.controller.pitch = Math.atan2(q.h.y - 0.15 - e.y, d); return [q.i.id, +d.toFixed(1)]; }, window.__ev0 = G.stage.smash.events.length, window.__aimLamp())

steps.eval: (() => { const c = G.city.car, C = N.controller; const d = Math.hypot(c.pos.x - C.pos.x, c.pos.z - C.pos.z); if (d > 2.3) { const k = (d - 1.6) / d; C.setPose(C.pos.x + (c.pos.x - C.pos.x) * k, C.pos.z + (c.pos.z - C.pos.z) * k, 0, 0); } C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(c.pos.x - C.pos.x), -(c.pos.z - C.pos.z)); C.pitch = -0.1; return 1; })()
